queries.name: original_active_release
queries.sql:
SELECT p.slot,p.release_id,r.snapshot_id,r.input_hash,r.marts_hash,o.source_kind
FROM `nyc311-service-ops-20261118.nyc311_control.publication` p
LEFT JOIN `nyc311-service-ops-20261118.nyc311_control.releases` r ON r.release_id=p.release_id
LEFT JOIN `nyc311-service-ops-20261118.nyc311_raw.observations` o ON o.snapshot_id=r.snapshot_id
WHERE p.slot='active'

queries.name: counts_after_a
queries.sql:
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `nyc311-service-ops-20261118.nyc311_raw.observations` WHERE scope_hash=@scope AND source_kind=@kind) AS observations,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `nyc311-service-ops-20261118.nyc311_raw.observation_requests` r JOIN `nyc311-service-ops-20261118.nyc311_raw.observations` o USING(snapshot_id) WHERE o.scope_hash=@scope AND o.source_kind=@kind) AS captured_rows,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `nyc311-service-ops-20261118.nyc311_raw.requests_current` WHERE scope_hash=@scope AND source_kind=@kind) AS current_rows,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT request_id) FROM `nyc311-service-ops-20261118.nyc311_raw.requests_current` WHERE scope_hash=@scope AND source_kind=@kind) AS current_unique_keys,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `nyc311-service-ops-20261118.nyc311_control.releases` WHERE release_id IN (@a,@b,@failed)) AS registered_releases

queries.name: metrics_after_a
queries.sql:
WITH cases AS (SELECT * FROM `nyc311-service-ops-20261118.nyc311_reporting.fct_cases__r_cloud_replay_a`)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS case_count,COUNTIF(created_date IS NOT NULL) AS intake,
  COUNTIF(is_recorded_closure) AS recorded_closures,COUNTIF(is_backlog) AS observed_backlog,
  SUM(target_numerator) AS target_numerator,SUM(target_denominator) AS target_denominator,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(target_numerator),SUM(target_denominator)) AS within_demo_target,
  COUNTIF(is_p90_eligible) AS p90_eligible_count,
  (SELECT ANY_VALUE(p90) FROM (SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(elapsed_hours,0.9) OVER() AS p90 FROM cases WHERE is_p90_eligible)) AS p90_elapsed_hours
FROM cases
